props.title: Supporting Soju
props.lead: Soju is free and will stay free. You don't need to pay for anything to use it.

props.title: If you want to pay something

props.text: Buy one of our games. [Don't Sell the Cat](games/dont-sell-the-cat.html) is $6.99 for Mac and Windows, and that money pays for work on Soju. We don't take donations yet.
Companies can buy the card at the bottom of the Soju sidebar for 30 days. [How it works](sponsor.html).

Some store links on Soju's Discover page may later be marked **Supports Soju**. Buying through one of those can earn us a commission from the store; the price is the same for you. Links without the mark earn nothing, and the mark never changes search order or prices. None are switched on yet.
A game being for sale doesn't mean it runs on a Mac. Check [what we've tested](./#works) first.

items: [Report a game](https://github.com/BCD1210/soju/issues/new?template=compatibility.yml) you tried, whether it worked or not, with your Mac and macOS version.
Send fixes, translations or clearer docs through [GitHub](https://github.com/BCD1210/soju).
Tell a friend who games on a Mac.
